quiz.q: Which SQL statement matches an HTTP POST that creates something?
quiz.explain: POST creates, INSERT adds a new row.

quiz.q: What happens with `UPDATE books SET copies = 0;` (no WHERE)?
quiz.explain: Without WHERE, UPDATE and DELETE apply to every row in the table.

quiz.q: Without ORDER BY, the order of rows is…
quiz.explain: Postgres returns rows in whatever order is fastest. Always ORDER BY when order matters.

quiz.q: `SELECT title FROM books ORDER BY title LIMIT 2;` returns…
quiz.explain: ORDER BY sorts A→Z, LIMIT keeps the first 2.

flashcards.back: Create = INSERT, Read = SELECT, Update = UPDATE, Delete = DELETE.
